name: Tote
subheader: Shopping guidance for every customer. Powered by AI.
details: Tote gives every shopper a personal AI stylist. It learns each customer's taste, asks about their lifestyle and the occasion, and returns tailored picks in a natural conversation — turning browsing into guided shopping and lifting conversion for the brands that deploy it.

name: Shotcall
details: Shotcall was a community and marketplace platform that connected gamers, streamers, and creators directly with their fans for interactive gaming sessions — letting people play video games alongside the creators, athletes, and influencers they follow. Backed by Initial Capital, New Stack, and Lerer Hippeau; no longer live.

name: Koshi
subheader: Your cozy little corner of the internet.
details: Koshi is a small, warm social space that feels more like a late-night café than a feed. Instead of metrics and infinite scroll, it gives people their own cozy corner of the internet — a personal, welcoming spot to hang out with a handful of others.

name: Grapevine
subheader: Turn your network into your pipeline.
details: Grapevine turns warm introductions into a measurable sales channel for B2B teams. Create a product page, share it through your network, and reward the people who send referrals — paying only when a referral actually converts. A pipeline built on relationships instead of cold outreach.

name: Viridian
subheader: We build the AI your business needs.
details: Viridian is a studio that builds and ships production AI for teams without an ML org of their own — the systems, agents, and integrations a business actually needs, wired into the tools they already use and maintained long after launch.

name: PartnerHire
subheader: Find the right AI expert, faster.
details: PartnerHire is a marketplace that connects businesses with vetted AI and automation experts. Define your project, get tailored pitches from hand-picked professionals across 50+ project types, and manage scoping and contracts in one place — so the specialist you bring on actually moves the work forward.

name: Trace
details: Trace is a presale marketplace for fashion. List a piece you want before you buy it, and others bid to buy or rent it after you've worn it — each bid lowering what you pay. A cleaner, more circular way to get the piece you can't stop thinking about.
